question: Which option is correct about the below code? import java.util.*; class ThreadSample extends Thread{ public void run(){ for(int time=1;time<5;time++){ try{Thread.sleep(1000);}catch(InterruptedException e) {System.out.println(e);} System.out.println(time); } } } public class ThreadExample{ public static void main(String args[]){ ThreadSample t1=new ThreadSample(); ThreadSample t2=new ThreadSample(); t1.run(); t2.run(); System.out.println("hello"); } }
